subject: SCIM delta + RBAC mapping: evidence triage for CareHarbor
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@careharbor.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@careharbor.com
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: SCIM delta export + RBAC mapping request for SOC2 assessment

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for taking our SOC2 packet request. We're midway through our vendor review and the auditor has a couple of follow-ups on provisioning. Can you provide a recent SCIM delta export (day-of-week snapshot is fine) showing user lifecycle events for the last 30 days, plus an RBAC role matrix that maps roles to privileges for the CareHarbor tenant?

Specifically the auditor asked for: 
- SCIM delta with timestamps and resource types (users, groups, serviceAccounts)
- Examples of SAML assertions for an interactive login and a service-to-service session
- Role-to-permission mapping and a short explanation of any guardian or elevation workflows

We know redaction may be needed; if you can provide a sanitized sample and a plan for full delivery, that would be great. Procurement also asked for an estimated turnaround to include in our security questionnaire timeline.

Appreciate it —
Maria Lopez
Senior IT Risk Analyst
CareHarbor Inc.

Attachment: sample_request_template.pdf (pdf, 98KB)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@careharbor.com>, security@careharbor.com
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SCIM delta export + RBAC mapping request for SOC2 assessment

Looping you both in — Maria from CareHarbor needs a 30-day SCIM delta sample, SAML assertion examples, and an RBAC role matrix for their auditor. I flagged that we should sanitize any PII/service account secrets and deliver a redacted bundle plus a short delivery plan.

Jordan — can you own the RBAC matrix and the short explainer about guardian/elevation workflows? Sean — can you pull a delta export for the CareHarbor tenant and produce a sanitized CSV (showing event types: create/update/deactivate, timestamps, resource type, actor) and include a note about retention windows?

I put an expected turnaround of EOW (Tue 9/8) to give procurement room; if that feels tight, say so. I'll handle the SAML assertion samples (we can create a small set of non-prod assertions for the auditor).

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: request_forwarded_eml.eml (eml, 12KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@careharbor.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SCIM delta export + RBAC mapping request for SOC2 assessment

Thanks Naomi — quick clarifying items before I assemble the RBAC workbook: 

1) For CareHarbor tenant, do they want role definitions scoped to application-level roles (console, API, data plane) or a consolidated company-wide role sheet? My plan is to do both: a consolidated role matrix plus per-svc snippets for console/API.

2) Guardian/elevation workflows: we have two patterns in prod — (a) time-bound admin escalation via a request+approval ticket that grants scoped console elevation for up to 4 hours, and (b) JIT ephemeral service account tokens issued by the token service for CI jobs. Which of these should we document in more depth? I suggest documenting both but marking one as "recommended" depending on the auditor ask.

3) Any constraints on including user email addresses in the RBAC sample? I can use placeholders (userX@redwood.ai) and include a mapping file for owners.

Sean — if you can indicate retention windows for SCIM deltas and provide a sanitized CSV sample, I'll draft the workbook and the small narrative for the auditor. Target to upload both to the shared Drive link by Tue 9/8 5pm PT.

Jordan Blake
Senior Product Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: rb_named_template.xlsx (xlsx, 28KB)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@careharbor.com>, security@careharbor.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, procurement@careharbor.com
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SCIM delta export + RBAC mapping request for SOC2 assessment

Hi Maria — quick update and delivery plan: 

1) SCIM delta: Sean attached a sanitized sample CSV (careharbor_scim_delta_sample.csv) to the Drive link below. It includes event type, resource, timestamp (ISO8601), actor role (system|admin|api), and a tokenized identifier. No PII or real emails are included. Retention: we persist SCIM change logs for 90 days; full export availability requires a signed DPA for long-term access.

2) RBAC matrix: Jordan prepared a consolidated workbook and per-service tabs. The workbook maps roles to capabilities and lists documented elevation workflows (admin escalation via ticket, ephemeral CI tokens). Role owners are tokenized in the sample; we can provide a redacted owners list on request.

3) SAML assertions: I created two non-prod assertion samples (interactive and service-to-service) and redacted NameID and IP addresses. Those are in saml-assertion-samples.txt.

Delivery: I've uploaded the three artifacts to the shared folder and sent a DocuSign link for the DPA clause that allows auditors to receive full exports. If procurement needs earlier scoring, we can provide the sample bundle now and await DPA to hand over production logs.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2cD3eF4gHiJk
DocuSign (DPA): https://app.hellosign.com/s/CA-Doc-12345

If this works, I'll mark the request as satisfied and follow up with a short notes pack that the auditor can attach to their SOC2 evidence folder.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: careharbor_scim_delta_sample.csv; redwood_rbac_role_matrix_v2.xlsx; saml-assertion-samples.txt
